newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon sets opposition unionist free.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon sets opposition unionist free.

text.p: Lebanon's Prosecutor General has ordered the release of labour leader Yasser Nehme, accused of publicising false news abroad undermining the country's reputation.

Prosecutor General Adnan Addoum issued the order late Wednesday night "for health-related reasons" to allow Nehme to return home, judicial sources said. But Nehme would still face questioning by judicial authorities later on Thursday.
The authorities earlier ordered the detention of another labour leader Elias Abou Rizk. Nehme is secretary general of Abou Rizk's branch of the CGTL.

Judicial sources said Abou Rizk and Nehme had sent letters to the International Labour Confederation claiming that Abou Rizk had received threats of assassination. They could be jailed for at least six months.
The arrest of Abou Rizk has brought widespread protests from political parties, labour unions and opposition politicians.
